name: pulp-platform
description: Pulp artifacts of platforms a Mac cannot host as a plug-in (lanes/platforms.py), read by lanes/platform_runner.py: Linux ELF and Windows PE images read statically; WebAssembly modules read statically and run under Pulp's own Node host checks; an iOS host app installed on a booted simulator; an Android APK installed and launched on an emulator. Roots: checkout = the checkout the artifact was built from; artifact = the artifact; other = a second artifact recorded in the identity probes (any; it is read, never run).
